text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card (53.0% of 264, expected 15.6%, risk-adjusted 6.64, z 8.95, 14 documented, 6 of 140, 1 of 10). The headline and the cautious 'inconclusive' leaning fit the evidence. The summary explains billed level against complexity, and it notes the documentation limits and that time is not recorded. The cited claim C0125935 supports the low-complexity example. Weaknesses: the next steps are generic and lack specific claim IDs; the summary repeats its own caveats; and one rationale detail is slightly loose.","problems":["Next steps are generic: no specific claim IDs are named for record requests, and 'Re-screen the provider' is vague.","The 'appears within the 5+ condition stratum' claim is supported by the card (62.1% vs 25.6%) but gives no numbers in the text.","The summary says 'the few charts returned all support the billed level', but the 6 documented 99215 claims were only a small sample (6 of 140), so this is thin evidence; it is acknowledged but the headline leans on it.","Statement that 1 of 10 moderate-plus notes lacking a lab line is a 'weak signal of note inflation' over-interprets a single instance.","The single cited claim is a low-complexity exception; the high-complexity claims are mentioned only loosely, and C0125700 and C0125819 are not in the cited list."]}
